summary: Clearwater County lookout: 55-ft tree platform (1920), 70-ft pole L-6 tower (1932), listed as ruins by 1965. Drive-up site; no current description found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts date the first structure, a tree platform, to 1920. Forest Lookouts quotes a 1915 Potlatch report that already names the Jericho lookout, and a February 1921 item reporting cabins built there. The story gives 1920 as the platform date and notes that a 1915 report already refers to the Jericho lookout, so the site may predate the platform.

notes_for_editor: Three sources only. Sources 1 and 2 agree on 1920, 1932 and 1965 but are short; source 3 is a compiled set of quotes from Potlatch annual reports, The Timberman and the Elk River Sentinel, which I read only as quoted on that page. The 1915 reference to 'the Jericho lookout' may describe an earlier structure, and the record does not say what it was. Land ownership and current access rules were not found; the site is not described as public or private anywhere I read. The brief record's kind 'tower' is accurate for the 1932-1965 structure but the site began as a tree platform. A web search turned up a Jericho Tower climbing page, which is a different feature and was not used. No photographs with direct image URLs were found.
